title: Anthropic IPO is set to redraw VC power rankings, with lesser-known firms like Spark Capital poised for outsized returns compared with larger, blue-chip rivals (George Hammond/Financial Times)
summary: George Hammond / Financial Times: Anthropic IPO is set to redraw VC power rankings, with lesser-known firms like Spark Capital poised for outsized returns compared with larger, blue-chip rivals — Small group of lesser-known firms primed for returns at multiples that would surpass larger, blue-chip rivals.
